objective: Integrate useful PR67 work onto current main and deliver evidenced local capability improvements with explicit economic tradeoffs.
authorization: 2026-09-16 user correction: current main as base, reference PR67 improvements; user permits relaxing economic thresholds for local enhancement.
selected_groups: settled ordinary rights no longer block fresh recovery
retained_for_comparison_not_deleted: ordinary admission expansion and tactical entry

economic_screen.baseline_for_each_case: same main with identical universe, dates, costs, runtime and inputs

capability_requirement: At least one reproduced main failure in real production behavior corrected with regression and integration evidence; economic neutrality alone is not improvement.
release_scope: local holding/recovery/reliability enhancement; no claim of universal or future out-of-sample generalization
historical_acceptance: Original contracts and failed reports remain preserved. Old 15x/weak-nine+10%/start-retention-vs-lucky-nominal requirements are research diagnostics, not this limited release gate.
nonnegotiable: preserve real holdings and pending obligations
budget: One selected combination, then remove an identified harmful component if needed; no nearby parameter sweep. Expand verification only for a stable candidate.
